set: B: acting, one sheet of each of the eight states the page uses (nervous, scared, confident, angry, shocked, plain, exhausted, proud), with no time and no word on it

issues.what: the wilted arrow's tail splits into two rounded prongs, so the shape reads at a glance as a white blob standing on two little legs or feet (like a tooth)
issues.fix: wilt it by bending and drooping the whole tail as one piece, or by sagging the head; never split the tail into two stubs

issues.where: the arrow at the moment the beam hits, frames 2 to 4
issues.what: no recoil and no squash on impact; the pose stays the same while it is burned, and it only drifts around, so the hit barely registers as acting
issues.fix: add a sharp squash and knock-back on the first hit frame, then a held flinch (tilted, tip pulled away) before it settles into the smoking stillness

issues.where: frames 3 to 12 compared with B-04 and B-06
issues.what: the burn on the tip is gone by frame 3 and the arrow is clean and sharp again, then it is singed again in B-06 and restored in B-08 frame 3 with no change shown; the damage comes and goes, so it does not read as the same character with the same injury
issues.fix: keep one damage track: carry the scorched tip through B-05 and B-06, and only clear it at a visible recovery beat (a shake-off or a stretch) before B-08's straighten-up

issues.what: it holds one identical pose for six frames, then slides down and right with no wind-up and no change of shape, like a plain pointer
issues.fix: give the wait a small life (a lean or tilt toward the checkbox) and add a little crouch before the move and a settle after it

issues.where: the landing by the checkbox, frames 4 to 6
issues.what: it arrives from the smear with no squash on landing; the relief is held but there is no impact to mark the arrival
issues.fix: squash it on the first frame by the checkbox, then overshoot and settle over two or three frames

issues.what: twelve frames of a slow turn and then standing still, with no anticipation before the turn and no settle; the feeling is neutral and is hard to name
issues.fix: add a small dip before it swings upright and a stretch as it rises, so the turn reads as resolve rather than a rotation

issues.where: frame 9, the glass panel crashing beside it
issues.what: it is hidden behind the falling glass and shows no flinch in frames 10 to 12; it simply stands where it was
issues.fix: add a one-frame flinch away from the crash and a short look back at it

issues.what: the press is a motion blur with no squash on contact with the button
issues.fix: squash the arrow on the button for one frame before it springs back up

issues.what: did not read: angry reads as stunned and smoking after a beam hits its tip and burns it. A tip that glows red and steam vented in anger are not in the read.
issues.fix: Anger as the arrow's own: the tip glowing red from inside and steam in bursts with the body squared at the boss, so that it is not taken for an arrow that has been hit.

issues.what: did not read: shocked reads as singed and recovering, then nervous and impatient, glancing about while a timer bar drains. The double take, the stretch tall and the snap back are not in the read.
issues.fix: The double take of Shocked as a held pose when the health jumps back: a look, a second look, the stretch tall, then the snap back.

reads.read: cautious and curious; it sneaks in low along the divider under 'I am not a robot', settles over the verification text and waits, then edges down, as if about to be checked
startled by a hole blasted in the floor beside it, it darts away in a smear and lands by the ticked checkbox and 'Humanity Confirmed'; relieved, a little proud, settling
calm resolve; once confirmed it turns from pointing right to pointing straight up and stands tall, ready to set off
has just been told 'Invalid input', then a beam hits its tip and burns it; stunned and smoking, it takes the hit and holds still
singed and recovering, then hurries past a 'session will expire' warning, shoves at 'Stay', and glances about anxiously while a timer bar drains; nervous, impatient
zapped by a sparking robot arm, it recoils and cowers; the machine falls apart and a glass panel crashes beside it; it stands up shaken, facing a smoking Submit button
worn out and dejected; as it nears the burnt Submit button it wilts and its tail splits, it droops, then drags itself to the button
it pulls itself upright on the Submit button, determined, presses it in a blur, then stands on the wreckage, triumphant but tired, as the light dims
